title: Uruguayan Roast Beef with French Baguette
description: A tender and flavorful roast beef served with a crusty French baguette, perfect for a special occasion.

ingredients.name: Indulgent
ingredients.notes: optional, add to roast for extra flavor

instructions: Season the roast beef with salt and pepper on both sides.
Heat the roast in a large oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat.
Sear the roast beef for 2-3 minutes on each side, or until browned.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and roast for 20 minutes per kilogram, or until cooked to your desired level of doneness.
Remove the roast from the oven and let it rest for 10-15 minutes.
Slice the French baguette into 1-inch thick slices.
Serve the roasted beef with the baguette slices on the side.
Optional: drizzle with the indulgent sauce (see notes)
